visual_observations: Fig1a: posterior side has four network blocks for means/std of library factor and latent z; sample colors distinguish latent blue, observed batch green and input counts orange.
Generative side separates frequency f_w(z,s), dropout f_h(z,s), and cell-size scaling; dashed exits point to downstream tasks rather than a hypothesis legend.

Fig1b: runtime in minutes uses log-scale tick spacing; horizontal input size in thousands of cells has a gap before1M. Dashed lines connect methods; isolated early-stopping marker at1M must not be read as a full series.
Source computational arrows are schematic and omit some explicit joins; reading Methods supplies conditioning and ZINB likelihood.
elements_and_relations: See independently editable reconstruction semantics in ../../examples/scvi/figure_spec.json (16 elements,15 directed dependencies); source Figure1b represents methods, runtime minutes, input-size cell counts, hardware context and720-gene restriction.
source_specific_boundaries: Fig1b uses BRAIN-LARGE,720 selected genes and specified CPU/GPU/hardware; no claim of universal runtime ranking.
Cells and genes are not donor-level experimental replicates.
Batch removal is a modeling aim/benchmark result, not guaranteed conditional independence in every encoder output.
Library factor l is log-normal per Methods, despite loose Gaussian wording in Results; positive-scale distinction preserved.

rules_transferred: Separate inference and generative dependency direction with explicit panel tasks
Represent observed batch separately from inferred library factor
Name multiplicative scaling at a join node
Distinguish distribution parameter mean from marginal expectation
Inspect actual text fit and endpoint geometry after rendering
not_transferable: 2018 latent-variable distributions to arbitrary later scvi-tools configurations
Runtime numbers to another hardware/gene set
Clustering or embeddings as causal biology
